transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I just haven't been feeling like myself lately. I used to do things... you know, painting, hiking, choir... family gatherings on Sundays. But now... I don't know. Even when I have a free hour, I just sit there. I just... can't seem to care about any of it anymore.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time lately?

I suppose so. It's... um... most days it just feels like there's this heavy gray film over everything. I can be standing in a classroom full of students at work, or... or just at home with my husband, and I still just feel... hollow. Just... close to tears, I guess.
Do you still enjoy things you used to find pleasurable?
No... not really. Like I mentioned before... the painting, the choir... I just don't have it in me anymore. I just sit there. I don't care about doing any of it.
Do you feel any pleasure when you do things that normally would bring you happiness?

No... like I just said, I really don't. Even if I have a free hour for hiking, or... or those Sunday family gatherings I used to go to... I just sit there. There's no happiness in it. I just can't seem to care.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while. Maybe about eight months? It's... it's been building up since I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative at work. Just... around then, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't exactly been paying attention to it, but... I don't think so. My clothes seem to fit the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how you've been moving lately?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I guess I'm just moving the same as always.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?

Um... I haven't... I don't have a plan to actually do anything like that. But... well, sometimes when I'm working late in the studio, I just... I catch myself thinking that it would be a relief if I just didn't wake up. 

It... it kind of scared me. Enough that I finally told my husband about it. I just... I couldn't keep dealing with those thoughts by myself.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I can still grade papers and do my work at the school just fine. I haven't really noticed any trouble with that.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling extremely sad or hopeless in the last two weeks?

Um... yes, I suppose. It's... it's hard to explain. Most days, it just feels like there's this heavy, gray film over everything. Even when I'm standing in a classroom full of students, or just at home with my husband... I still just feel... hollow. And... close to tears, I guess.
Have you felt like you're moving slower than usual or like you're restless and can't sit still?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently bad every day?
Um... I don't think so. It's just... pretty much the same every day, I guess. I haven't really noticed feeling any better.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you were unable to get out of bed or take care of your basic needs?
No... I get out of bed. I still have to go to work, so... I just do what I need to do, I guess.
Have you had any feelings of worthlessness?

Um... maybe a little. I just... at work, I help with this curriculum project. And if anything goes wrong, even something really small... I just start thinking I'm letting the students down. And... I don't know, I just feel like I'm wasting all the sacrifices my parents made for me to even have this opportunity. So... yeah, I guess.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you felt okay, not sad or empty, for at least a few hours?

Um... not really. Most days it just feels like... like there's this heavy gray film over everything. It doesn't really go away. Even if I'm standing in the classroom with the students, or... or at home with my husband... I still just feel hollow. And... close to tears, I guess. So... no.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where your depression was significantly worse than usual?
Um... no, I don't think so. It's just... pretty much the same every day. I haven't really noticed a difference.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you felt nearly back to your normal self?
Um... no. Not really. It's just... been the same. I haven't felt like myself in a while.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you were unable to work or perform your usual activities due to your depression?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I've missed a few of my teaching sessions lately... and I've been kind of avoiding the student workshops. I just... I can't keep up with it all right now. And at home... my husband has been doing a lot more. I just kind of withdraw, I guess. I don't really want to do the family plans... I just don't feel like I can push through it on my own right now.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where your depression made it extremely difficult for you to do even the smallest tasks?
Um... no, I don't think it's been quite that bad. I can still do the basics, mostly. It's just... the bigger things that are hard.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you were completely unable to work or take care of yourself due to your depression?
No, not completely unable. Like I said, I can still do the basics. It's just... hard.
